components.name: StreamingResponse
components.doc: Text that arrives word by word, the way a model response does: each word fades up out of a soft blur behind a caret, the pace breathes at punctuation, and the caret leaves when the text settles. The status line can pause, skip to the end or replay. With reduced motion the whole text is shown at once.

members.name: text
members.doc: The text to stream. Blank lines split it into paragraphs. If the text grows (a real stream appending to it), the reveal carries on from where it is; any other change starts over.

members.name: speed
members.doc: Words revealed per second. Sentence ends and commas add a short natural pause.

members.name: playing
members.doc: Whether the stream is running (controlled). Set it to false to hold the text where it is.

members.name: defaultPlaying
members.doc: Whether the stream starts running on mount (uncontrolled).

members.name: onPlayingChange
members.doc: Called when the built-in controls pause, resume or replay the stream.

members.name: instant
members.doc: Shows the whole text at once with no stream, for a response that had already finished.

members.name: controls
members.doc: Shows the status line with the progress, pause, skip and replay controls.

members.name: caret
members.doc: Shows the caret while text is arriving.

members.name: onProgress
members.doc: Called as words appear, with the number of words shown and the total.

members.name: onComplete
members.doc: Called once per run when the last word has appeared.

members.name: className
members.doc: Class name added to the root element.
